# externs-phpstubs

> Read-only Kotlin registry for PHP built-in function, class, method, and constant stubs with O(1) existence checks.

`PhpStubs` is the singleton entry point. Hot-path `contains*` methods check existence without deserialization. Cold-path `search*` methods return `StubRecord` instances with lazy caching. All input names are normalized (lowercase, strip leading `/`).

## Instructions for Agents

- Use `PhpStubs.containsFunc/Class/Method/Const(name)` for existence checks on the hot path.
- Use `PhpStubs.searchFunc/Class(name)` for `StubRecord` retrieval on the cold path.
- Pass method names with optional `className` parameter: `searchMethod("query", "mysqli")`.
- Omit `className` for suffix-only lookup: `containsMethod("query")` scans all classes.
- Access `StubRecord.name` and `StubRecord.extension` for metadata.
- Use `getFuncRawData(name)` to get raw bytes for `IValue` reconstruction with `DftByteArraySerializerImpl`.
- Never instantiate `PhpStubs` — it is an `object` (singleton).
- Never assume case-sensitive matching. All lookups normalize to lowercase.

## API Reference

- [Stubs API](llms/stubs.md): `PhpStubs`, `StubRecord`, `StubSection`, exceptions, thread-safety model.
